entities.summary: Karl Richard Jonsson Göransson is a Swedish racing driver. He is a four-time champion of the Swedish Touring Car Championship winning it for West Coast Racing in 2004, 2005, 2008 and 2010. He won the Scandinavian Touring Car Championship in 2016 for Polestar Cyan Racing.
